_note: v2 (owner 2026-10-23): stories people have NOT heard, plus world mythology told in its own world (culture field: the picture system then uses that culture's costume, buildings and landscape, nothing Indian). angle = what makes a viewer share, comment, save or follow. untold = a katha that is rare in Hindi video. Sources are where the owner verifies; every world myth names the attested source because several (Slavic, Polynesian, Celtic) are thinly or lately attested: label that on screen. Living sacred traditions with restricted stories (Aboriginal Dreamtime, many Native American nations) are left out on purpose.
